channel.title: Learn with Ian – Christmas activities for preschool
channel.description: Christmas activities for preschool: free printables and free cartoons from Learn with Ian. Ages 2 to 6.

item.title: Christmas Words Game for Preschool: What Is Missing?
item.description: A free Christmas words game for preschool, ages 2 to 6. Learn six Christmas words in English with a 15-minute memory game. Free printable activities included.

item.title: Free Christmas Story Sequencing Pictures for Preschoolers
item.description: Free printable Christmas Eve story sequencing cards for preschool and toddlers. Four pictures from the Learn with Ian cartoon Ian's Christmas Eve: cut them out and put the story in order. Ages 2 to 6. PDF in US Letter and A4, with a free video to watch first.
